document: Green Means Go - Inventory Database Mapping

executive_summary.one_paragraph: Green Means Go does not hold a per-crop inventory. Every farm assessment, whatever the crop, is built from the same generic on-farm model (IPCC 2019 Tier 1 N2O from the user's fertiliser rates, on-farm fuel CO2, irrigation water by system type, land occupation = area) plus purchased inputs that are matched by semantic search to background datasets in a canonical store of AGRIBALYSE 3.2 and ecoinvent 3.11, then characterised with ReCiPe 2016 midpoint (H) for Ghana and Nigeria (EF 3.1 for Canada). The crop name only switches a few hooks (rice methane, legume N2O credit, Ghana yield benchmarks, recommendations). Processing works the same way: electricity, fuel, water, packaging, waste, transport and refrigerants are shared across all facility types, and only the raw-material name changes the result.

per_commodity.cocoa: Farm: generic inventory; Ghana yield guides 400-450 kg/ha; 5 Ghana measures. Processing: raw 'Cocoa beans' -> ecoinvent 'cocoa bean production, sun-dried' (Ghana for GH, RoW for NG). Only commodity with Ghana-specific farm-gate datasets in the store.
per_commodity.palm_oil: Farm: generic inventory, category Oils, no FFB token. Processing (PalmOilMill): raw material with 'palm' in the name -> ecoinvent 'palm fruit bunch production' (RoW, no GH/NG dataset); 'Fresh fruit bunches (FFB)' without 'palm' mismatches (GH -> Ghana cocoa). No FFB-to-CPO extraction rate; user enters kg FFB per tonne output.
per_commodity.maize: Farm: generic inventory; Ghana MoFA/FAO yield guides 1500-3500 kg/ha; 6 Ghana measures. Processing (Mill/FlourMaize): raw 'Maize kernels' -> ecoinvent 'maize grain production' (RoW for GH/NG; Canada, Quebec for CA).
per_commodity.groundnuts: Farm: generic inventory; 'groundnut'/'peanut' only act as a legume token giving a neighbouring crop a 20% N2O credit; own N fixation not modelled. Processing: no enum; hint 'groundnut production' has no dataset, so GH mismatches to Ghana cocoa, NG -> 'peanut seed production' RoW, CA -> protein pea. Treat processing results as unreliable.
per_commodity.honey: NOT SUPPORTED. No apiculture/livestock inventory path, no enum, no hint. If entered it is modelled as a generic field crop. Processing raw 'Raw honey' mismatches (GH cocoa, NG onshore petroleum, CA maple syrup). WFLDB honey datasets (US, CH) exist in the store but are never selected automatically.
per_commodity.tomato: Farm: generic inventory, category Vegetables, variety list only. Processing (VegetableProcessing): hint 'tomato' -> ecoinvent 'tomato production, processing grade' (RoW).
per_commodity.eggplant: Farm: generic inventory; no token in code. Processing: no hint; correct ecoinvent aubergine dataset reached only for NG; GH mismatches to Ghana cocoa.
per_commodity.cucumber: Farm: generic inventory; no token in code. Processing: no hint; store has only 'cucumber, heated greenhouse' GLO, reached only for NG; GH mismatches to Ghana cocoa.
per_commodity.chilli_peppers: Farm: generic inventory; 'pepper' sets frontend category Vegetables only. Processing: no hint, no chilli dataset in store; GH mismatches to Ghana cocoa.
per_commodity.bell_peppers: Farm: generic inventory; 'pepper' sets frontend category Vegetables only. Processing: no hint; store has bell pepper only as French unheated greenhouse; GH mismatches to Ghana cocoa.

top_data_quality_issues: Wizard pesticide entries never reach the engine (frontend key pesticides_used vs API model field pesticides; pydantic drops it).
Region location preference outranks similarity, so unknown raw materials in Ghana resolve to the Ghana cocoa dataset.
Kerosene maps to an aviation-kerosene dataset per kg while the amount is in MJ (about 37x overstatement); LPG, firewood, charcoal and unknown fuels collapse to diesel.
Ghana grid is calibrated to the official 0.35 kg CO2e/kWh; Nigeria uses the raw ecoinvent dataset (about 0.17).

The AWARE 2.0, USEtox 2.14, LANCA and IPCC GWP spreadsheets in data/ are not read by any code; only the ecoinvent 3.11 method pack (ReCiPe 2016, EF 3.1) in the store is used. Irrigation water characterises to zero.
Any fertiliser type the kernel does not know (SSP, MOP, organic, bio, foliar, 'None') is assigned 10% N and generates N2O.

how_this_was_produced.method: Three independent agents read the engine source (Rust kernel african_lca_backend/src, Python engine engine/, API app/) and EXECUTED the production input matcher (FarmLCA._match_input / FarmLCA.assess) for Ghana (GH) and Nigeria (NG), and the processing matcher for GH, NG and Canada (CA). Every parameter carries a code_location (file:line) so it can be checked.
how_this_was_produced.canonical_store: data/canonical/lca_engineer.sqlite: AGRIBALYSE 3.2 + ecoinvent 3.11 (45,852 processes) + ecoinvent 3.11 method pack (ReCiPe 2016 v1.03 midpoint (H), EF v3.1).
how_this_was_produced.matching_method: Semantic retrieval: cosine similarity of openai text-embedding-3-small embeddings over process name|category|location; candidates re-ranked by the region's location preference list (e.g. GH > WA > RAF > RoW > GLO). Scores in this file are cosine similarities (0-1).

how_to_read.input_name: The text the software builds from the user's form (or the user's free text) and sends to the matcher.
how_to_read.matched_process / by_region: The background LCI dataset in the canonical store that the input is resolved to (the 'consequential data'). Its full cradle-to-gate inventory is then solved and characterised.
how_to_read.on_farm_field_flows: Direct emissions computed by the Rust kernel (N2O, nitrate, CO2 from fuel, water, land) and the characterisation factors applied.
how_to_read.crop_specific_data: Values in the software that depend on the crop name. If this list is short it is because the engine is crop-agnostic (see engine_architecture_summary).

farm_production_support_status.generic_inventory_with_crop_hooks: Runs through the shared generic on-farm inventory AND the crop name triggers at least one engine behaviour (Ghana yield benchmark key, legume N2O credit token, recommendation measures, legacy per-kg factor).
farm_production_support_status.generic_inventory_name_only: Runs through the same shared generic on-farm inventory; the crop name is carried as a label and does not change any inventory value. Results are therefore not crop-specific.
farm_production_support_status.not_supported: No inventory model exists for this product system (e.g. apiculture). If entered anyway it is modelled as a generic field crop from area and fertiliser, which is not meaningful.
farm_production_support_status.note: The inventory numbers themselves are identical across the first two statuses. The distinction is only whether the crop name is recognised anywhere in the engine.

independent_re_execution.scope: 24 farm purchased-input rows (GH, NG), 33 processing raw-material rows (GH, NG, CA), 12 shared processing rows (GH, NG, CA); matched process name, source, location, ref_unit, uid and score (2 dp) compared; every matched process confirmed present in the SQLite processes table with the stated source and location.
independent_re_execution.determinism: GH farm sample run twice: identical processes; scores vary in the 4th decimal (embedding jitter). CA electricity match varies between two datasets (see note on that row).

code_citation_audit.partial_detail: cocoa IPCC SOC factor citation wording corrected in this version.

claims_list: default engine path and legacy Rust LCIA switch
crop name has no inventory effect except rice CH4, legume N2O credit, Ghana yield benchmarks, recommendations, ISO wording

Ghana grid calibrated to 0.35 kg CO2e/kWh, Nigeria not
processing fuel LHVs, diesel fallback, wastewater 0.8
data/ LCIA spreadsheets not read by code
processing enums never branched on by the Python engine

farm_path: Only five purchased-input families are extracted on the farm path: fertiliser (per application), fuel (diesel/petrol/kerosene/biodiesel words), grid electricity, pesticides (generic dataset), purchased compost. Seeds, irrigation water, packaging and transport are never purchased inputs.

Fertilisers mostly resolve to Agribalyse 3.2 'Adapted from WFLDB' RoW datasets (NPK, urea, DAP), SSP and MOP to ecoinvent 3.11 RoW; Organic to an Agribalyse RER dataset; Bio-fertilizer, Foliar and 'None' produce low-score nonsense matches (cocoa beans in GH).
Wizard pesticides never reach the engine: frontend posts 'pesticides_used', backend model expects 'pesticides' (verified).
